name: google_docs
description: List, search, or read the user's Google Docs. Call with action='list' to see recent docs, action='search' with a query to find docs by name, or action='read' with a doc_id (from a prior list/search result) to get a document's actual text content.

action.description: list: recent documents. search: find documents by name. read: get a specific document's text content.

query.description: Search term to match against document names. Required for action='search'.

doc_id.description: The Google Docs document ID to read. Required for action='read'. Get this from a prior list or search result's 'id' field - never guess one.

limit.description: Max number of documents to return for list/search. Defaults to 10.
